name: talentsia-do
description: Ten bilingual skills for capturing, organizing, planning, preparing, doing, following through and reviewing work.

interface.longDescription: Talentsia Do includes ten free skills: Clear My Head, Organize My Work, Plan My Day, Move Forward, Prepare, Do With Me, Follow Through, Make Room, Resume, and Review. One shared method in Portuguese and English keeps ideas distinct from commitments and reuses your own trusted records. Tools and permissions come from the host; no storage service, connected accounts or automatic future monitoring are included.
defaultPrompt: Use Clear My Head to capture what is on my mind.
Use Plan My Day to choose feasible work for today.
Use Review to reconcile my commitments.
